verdict.rationale: SumUp is a payments platform, not an AI agent or host application, so letting users plug MCP servers into it as a client is a category error. The evidence describes only provider-side capabilities: a managed MCP server that exposes SumUp APIs, and an Agent Toolkit that adds SumUp tools to other agent frameworks. Neither makes SumUp itself consume MCP tools, and that server-side evidence belongs to a different story.
